💡 The novelty lies in mimicking cytochrome c oxidase's binuclear center using a Ga-pyrazolate framework with densely packed Co(II)-porphyrin arrays spaced 6.53 Å apart, enabling hydrogen-bonded binuclear cooperativity that stabilizes *OOH and lowers the ORR barrier. This yields exceptional zinc-air battery performance (185 mW cm⁻², 150 h stability), ranking among the best MOF-based ORR catalysts.

Advanced Composites and Hybrid Materials | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access

Advanced Composites and Hybrid Materials | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in NaCl-assisted templating combined with Zn evaporation to create porous dodecahedral carbon hosting Co/CoS2 heterostructures within in-situ grown N,S co-doped carbon nanotubes. This synergy of hierarchical porosity, conductive networks, and heterointerface engineering yields superior bifunctional OER/ORR activity, enabling high-performance AEMFCs and durable liquid/flexible Zn-air batteries, advancing cost-effective non-precious metal catalysts for wearable energy devices.
